mike: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortemwe're doing a focused mini-game-day tomorrow 09:00 PT. Scope: routing convergence + partial restore + backup sanity checks. Need owners and quick pre-checks.

rachel: I'll own backups: verify last 14 snapshots across S3/GCS and check manifest parity. Will post results here.

vikram: I'll run the routing canary and a scripted failover in staging. Will measure convergence time and sticky-session behavior.

sara: I'll take the partial restore into dr-sandbox (metadata only) and run the smoke tests. Will timestamp each phase.

mike: Action items: 1) backups -> rachel -> due: today EOD; 2) routing canary -> vikram -> due: today EOD; 3) partial restore -> sara -> due: tomorrow 08:30 PT. Tag any observations with #dr-mini and #pattern.

rachel: backup checklist commands: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/ --recursive | tail -n 20`, `gsutil cat gs://redwood-backups/manifests/latest.json`. Found one manifest mismatch for 2026-05-07 (missing chunk-9), re-running inventory.

vikram: routing snippet I'll test: `failover_policy: primary=us-west1, secondary=eu-west1, grace=30s`. I'll push a small canary and report histograms.

sara: partial restore dry run in sandbox: metadata restore 22m, app restart 8m, smoke tests passed. Will list exact timestamps in the runbook.

mike: Noted patterns to watch: KV cache cold misses, leader lease drift, and routing table staleness. Please include any log excerpts.

dr-bot: Reminder: mini-game-day scheduled 2026-05-10T16:00:00Z. Channel will be created on run.

rachel: Backup inventory re-check: chunk-9 still not found in s3 but present in GCS. Opening ticket DR-MINI-1 and escalating to storage team.

vikram: Canary ran: initial latency spike ~150ms for 45s, then settled. KV cache misses peaked during spike. Attaching perf link in ticket.

sara: Runbook updated with measured timings and a rollback gate at 15m post-shift. Pushed PR and linked here.

mike: Good. Please drop a 1-line update when each ticket/action is complete. We'll use this thread for final go/no-go tomorrow 08:45 PT. :ok_hand:
